title: Insurance Claim Services Estimate Price Basis and Reinspection Thresholds
content:
**Estimating desk schedule — Insurance Claim Services.** The figures below govern how the company's estimate on a claim file is priced and delivered, and the amounts at which the carrier reinspects before approving.

## Terms

- **Company submits estimate** — whether the company sends its estimate directly to the carrier (otherwise it is delivered to the insured or their adjuster to submit), boolean.
- **Estimate submission target days** — calendar days after the claim file is opened by which the estimate is submitted or delivered, count.
- **Overhead percentage** — overhead percentage added to the estimate when general contractor overhead and profit applies, percent.
- **Profit percentage** — profit percentage added to the estimate when general contractor overhead and profit applies, percent.
- **Overhead and profit minimum trades** — minimum number of distinct trades on the estimate for overhead and profit to apply, count.
- **Program pricing discount** — discount from the company price list required by the carrier program agreement, percent.
- **Initial reinspection threshold** — estimate amount at or above which the carrier reinspects before approving, USD.
- **Supplement reinspection threshold** — supplement amount at or above which the carrier reinspects before deciding, USD.

## Schedule

| Arrangement | Company submits estimate | Target days | Overhead % | Profit % | Minimum trades for overhead and profit | Program pricing discount % | Initial reinspection threshold (USD) | Supplement reinspection threshold (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Homeowner Direct Pay Claim Support | no | 7 | 10 | 10 | 3 | 0 | 25000.00 | 5000.00 |
| Direction to Pay Claim Billing | yes | 5 | 10 | 10 | 3 | 0 | 25000.00 | 5000.00 |
| Assignment of Benefits Claim Billing | yes | 5 | 10 | 10 | 3 | 0 | 25000.00 | 5000.00 |
| Carrier Program Claim Billing | yes | 3 | 0 | 0 | 99 | 6.5 | 15000.00 | 2500.00 |
| Public Adjuster Coordinated Claim Billing | no | 7 | 10 | 10 | 3 | 0 | 25000.00 | 5000.00 |
| Commercial Large Loss Claim Administration | yes | 14 | 10 | 10 | 3 | 0 | 100000.00 | 25000.00 |

## Notes on the figures

- Carrier Program Claim Billing is the only arrangement with a program pricing discount (6.5 percent); its overhead and profit percentages are 0 and its minimum trade count is 99.
- On the other five arrangements overhead and profit are each 10 percent and need at least 3 distinct trades.
- The thresholds are inclusive: an amount equal to the threshold is at or above it.

*Illustration (hypothetical):* on Direction to Pay Claim Billing an estimate of 25000.00 USD is reinspected before approval, while one of 24999.99 USD is not; on Commercial Large Loss Claim Administration the same 25000.00 USD estimate stays below the 100000.00 USD threshold.
